training: cheap fitness F on training seeds (e.g. 2 seeds x 1,500 decisions per candidate per generation); seeds disjoint from all evaluation seeds
finalists: top K = 8 candidates by mean training F over the last 3 generations (not the single best run)
evaluation: each finalist on >= 20 unseen FlyBrain seeds from a pre-registered block, identical save state(s), identical 1,500-decision budget, plus 2 held-out save states if available
report: mean, median, 10th percentile and worst-case F; milestone attainment rates; loop fraction; comparison to Gen-0 and random on the same seeds
selection_rule: maximise the 10th-percentile F (robust), tie-break by median; reject candidates whose worst case is below Gen-0 median or whose milestone rate depends on < 3 seeds
livestream_brain: the robust champion; the frozen E23 T4 hash and controller hash are recorded and displayed; T5 is stated as unresolved
controls: re-run the champion with T4 injection/readout disabled and with shuffled T4 geometry on the same seeds to show the behaviour depends on vision
